response.sql: WITH film_copies AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating), differences AS (SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count, copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS rating_difference, copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER () AS overall_difference FROM film_copies) SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count, rating_difference, overall_difference FROM differences ORDER BY overall_difference DESC LIMIT 10
